manual.assortedutil.chapter.light_overla:
Press the key default "F7" to show the block light on the ground around you.

Red is where a monster can spawn at any time, yellow where one can only at night or a storm, and green where one never can.
manual.assortedutil.description: Graves, double doors, an item replacer, a clock, a light level overlay and damage numbers.
